footer.sourceLinkLabel: View the open-source code on GitHub
footer.summary: Keepfin helps you track and analyze your accounts and investments. It does not provide financial or investment advice.
footer.legalDescription: Information about the application's purpose, data limitations and investment risks.

purpose.title: Information and analysis
purpose.body: keepfin.io is an open-source tool that helps you track, review and analyze your finances and investments. Its information, charts and calculations are not financial or investment advice, personalized recommendations, or recommendations to buy or sell.

data.title: Data and calculations
data.body: Data from third parties or user entries may be delayed, incomplete or inaccurate. Valuations, returns and profit/loss calculations depend on the data, methods and assumptions used; their accuracy and timeliness are not guaranteed. Verify information with independent, reliable sources before making a transaction.

risk.title: Investment risks
risk.body: Past performance does not guarantee future results. Investments involve risks, including the loss of some or all of your principal. Keepfin does not guarantee returns or protection against losses.

decisions.title: Decisions and transactions
decisions.body: Do not use information in the application as the sole basis for investment decisions. Consider your financial situation, objectives and risk preferences, and seek advice from an appropriately authorized professional when needed. Your investment decisions and transactions are your own.

rights.title: Legal rights
rights.body: This notice does not remove rights granted by applicable law or exclude liabilities that cannot lawfully be limited.

wealth.title: Wealth management
wealth.subtitle: Follow your assets, plan ahead, and explore your financial position.
wealth.quoteHint: Quotes may be delayed. Refresh requests only the assets on this page.
wealth.emptyWatchlist: Search for an asset to start your watchlist.
wealth.name: Name
wealth.manualHint: Create property, private investments, or other assets. Add a value per unit for each valuation date, then record a purchase or opening position in an account.
wealth.addAssetToAccount: Open an account to add a position
wealth.deleteUnused: Only unused assets can be deleted. Assets with financial history are retained.
wealth.netWorthHint: Net worth is the value of included accounts minus your dated liabilities, converted to your reporting currency.
wealth.liabilityHint: Record a new dated balance as the debt changes. Use a zero balance to close a liability while retaining its history.
wealth.noTagsYet: No tags yet. Type a name to create one.
wealth.manageTagsHint: Create tags, or change their name and color. New tags are added to this record.
wealth.riskHint: Set your own limits to flag concentration, fees, liquidity, and emergency coverage. These checks are informational, not investment recommendations.
wealth.fireHint: Explore a financial independence scenario using your current net worth and the assumptions below. Amounts use your reporting currency.
wealth.feeRuleHint: Fee ratio compares fees in the last year with lifetime net contributions. Emergency coverage uses the smaller of your reserved fund and available cash.
wealth.projectionHint: Scenario only: constant nominal return, monthly compounding, contributions at month end, no inflation or tax adjustment. A dash means the target is not reached in this horizon or inputs are incomplete.
wealth.shareHint: Share a read-only report for selected accounts. Anyone with a public link can view it until expiry or revocation. A private link also requires the selected recipient to sign in.
wealth.publicShare: Leave empty for a public link
wealth.copyLinkHint: Copy this link now. The token is shown only when the link is created.
wealth.readOnlyShare: Read-only portfolio report. Private links require the owner's or recipient's session; sign in and reopen the link if needed.
wealth.providerHint: API keys stay on the server. Alpha Vantage supports US instruments and daily FX here; history access depends on your plan. Dividend import uses EODHD.
wealth.jobHint: Queue a durable refresh for an asset in your accounts or watchlist. Failed requests retry up to three attempts; use Refresh to see the latest status.
wealth.correctionHint: Corrections affect portfolio valuation for all users and take precedence over provider prices. Record a reason; remove the correction to restore provider data.
wealth.zenHint: Zen mode masks displayed financial values. It is a display preference, not an access restriction.
wealth.installHint: Use your browser's install or Add to Home Screen action when available. Financial data requires an online connection.
wealth.deleteTagHint: Remove this tag and its assignments. Financial records are preserved.
wealth.fxHint: The result at starting exchange rates includes prices, income, and fees with FX held constant. The remaining difference is attributed to exchange-rate changes.
wealth.dividendHint: Review gross dividends using holdings before the ex-dividend date and unadjusted amounts per share. Verify payment dates, currency, tax, and broker records before importing. Fees and withholding are not inferred.
wealth.splitHint: For a 2-for-1 split enter 2 new and 1 old share. For a 1-for-10 reverse split enter 1 and 10. Cost and cash remain unchanged; fractional shares are retained.
wealth.watchlistHint: Follow assets you do not own yet. Search, add them to the list and see their prices in one place.
wealth.watchSearchPlaceholder: Type a symbol or name, e.g. AAPL or Bitcoin
wealth.assetFormHint: Describe an asset that does not trade on an exchange. You enter its dated value in the next step.
wealth.currencyFixed: The currency cannot change after creation.
wealth.valuationHint: Enter the value of one unit with its date. A new value for the same date replaces the old one.
